subject: general
question: The amount of water in urine is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**95%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• A liquid **waste product **that the body **produces **and **excretes **is called **urine**.
 
• It is **secreted **by the **renal tubules**, **builds **up in the **bladder**, and is **eliminated **through the **urethra**.
 
• Despite containing between **91 **and **96** percent **water**, it also includes numerous additional **solid **and **liquid **components.
 
• Urine typically has a **pH **in the range of **5.5-7.0,** or around **6.2**.
 
• While vegetables and fruit result in a more alkaline pH, a **high protein diet **and **alcohol use** cause a **lower pH**.
 
• Urine's specific **gravity **could be between **1.002 **and **1.037.**
 
• Urine may have a daily **average calorific value** of around **100 kcal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• 
 Only **68 compounds **with a **concentration **of** 10 mg/L** or higher make up over 99 percent of the urine solutes.
 
 
• 
 Actually,** 42 chemicals **are at play.
 
 
• 
 These categories could apply to them:

 
 
• 
 **Sodium, potassium, calcium, magnesium, **and **chloride** are examples of electrolytes.
 
 
• 
 Nitrogen-containing substances like **urea **and **creatinine**
 
 
• 
 **Vitamins**
 
 
• 
 **Hormones**
 
 
• 
 Acids that are **organic**, like** uric acid**
 
 
• 
 Various **organic substances**.
